Messages.Author: Errol T
Messages.Body:
In a game the other day a guy went to diablerize my vamp in topor,I went
to block this action as I feel it is an action and can be blocked He felt
otherwise, What do you guys think. The rules are a little vague but it
does refer to this as an action therfore to me blockable.

Errol

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Errol T <etre...@compusmart.ab.ca> writes:



As blockable as any other zero-stealth (D) action.

Encountering a vampire in your own Torpor region (to rescue or to diab) is
a +1 stealth undirected action. Encountering a vampire in anyone else's
Torpor region (to rescue or to diab) is a zero-stealth directed action.

==========

action.

Messages.Body:

Peace Errol,

Encountering a vampire in torpor is most definitely an action (regardless of
what you intend to do when you get there). It can definitely be blocked.
It is plus one stealth vs. your own and zero stealth vs. other Meth's vamps.
